title: I released my AI-assisted interactive sci-fi game, Unwritten Meridian: Book One
author: Final_Salamander_796
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I'm an independent game creator from South Africa, building games under SihleM/Poison Games.

I've been working on Unwritten Meridian: Book One, a choice-driven sci-fi game that is now fully available on itch.io.

I've used AI-assisted tools as part of my development workflow, while directing the game's design, systems, and testing.

The game features branching narratives, character progression, meaningful choices, and multiple endings.

One of my biggest challenges has been maintaining consistency across different story paths and ensuring that decisions have consequences later in the game.

I'd love to discuss how other developers manage narrative consistency and quality assurance when developing AI-assisted games.

Game: https://sihlem.itch.io/unwritten-meridian

I'm also open to constructive feedback from anyone interested in trying it.
